setup.title: Build Night: Assembling an NVIDIA Graphics Card, a Water-Cooled PC, and the First Game
setup.style: Live-action, cinematic product-assembly documentary: clean macro inserts of parts and tools, a bright daytime workshop that turns into a dim, neon-lit gaming room at night.

cast.name: Alex
cast.description: Alex, a man in his late twenties with tousled sandy-blond hair and light stubble, wearing a black T-shirt under a dark-navy canvas work apron, black cargo trousers, and a black anti-static wrist strap on his left wrist.

extras.music: Relaxed lo-fi hip-hop beat with soft electric piano and vinyl crackle, kept at low volume throughout.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a bright morning maker workshop, where Alex stands by a white workbench with a stack of boxes. Alex, a man in his late twenties with sandy-blond hair wearing a black T-shirt under a dark-navy canvas work apron and black cargo trousers, steps up to the workbench carrying a heavy stack of sealed component boxes. He sets the tall stack down beside an empty green anti-static mat. Resting his hands near his apron pockets, he glances over the clean workspace. The boxes remain neatly stacked on the white surface. The camera remains stationary in a wide establishing shot, keeping the spacious room and workbench dominant.

shots.prompt: A top-down shot of a brightly lit green anti-static mat, where graphics card components lie neatly knolled. On the green anti-static mat, graphics card components rest in symmetrical rows, including a bare matte-black circuit board, a silicon GPU chip in a tray, memory modules, a copper heatsink, three black fans, and a black-and-green shroud. Alex, wearing a dark-navy canvas apron and a black anti-static wrist strap, lowers a transparent tray of miniature silver and black screws into the remaining open corner. He aligns the tray with the grid and smoothly pulls his hands back. The camera remains in a locked top-down ninety-degree flat-lay angle looking straight down onto the mat.

shots.prompt: A tight macro close-up of a bare circuit board on a green workbench mat under bright task lighting. Alex, wearing a black T-shirt and a black anti-static wrist strap on his left wrist, reaches down and snaps a coiled black grounding cord firmly onto the corner brass stud of the green mat. With grounded hands, he grips the outer fiberglass edges of the unpopulated black printed circuit board and lifts it steadily off the bench. He tilts the rigid board slightly toward the overhead lamp, illuminating an intricate grid of microscopic gold contact pads gleaming against the matte black solder mask. The camera holds a tight macro close-up, angling low over the mat before tilting upward smoothly as the board rises.

shots.prompt: An extreme macro close-up of the graphics card socket on a dark-blue mat under bright neutral overhead light. On the dark-blue mat, the matte-black circuit board rests with its central socket and gold contact pads clearly visible. Alex, wearing a black anti-static wrist strap, maneuvers a metallic vacuum suction pen holding the GPU processor package over the socket. He pauses briefly to align the tiny gold triangle on the green substrate with the white silkscreen marker on the board. With steady hands, he lowers the silver-lidded chip squarely onto the gold pads and releases the vacuum seal before lifting the tool away. The camera remains nearly stationary at an extreme macro close-up, tilted downward over the socket area.

The camera maintains an extreme macro close-up angled slightly downward across the circuit board, locking steadily onto the chip.

shots.prompt: An extreme close-up of the power delivery components on the circuit board under cool white daylight LEDs. On the dark-grey mat, the circuit board displays its central GPU and memory ring beside an aligned row of cylindrical capacitors with silver tops. Alex, holding fine-tipped metal tweezers, aligns the final cube-shaped black ferrite choke over its designated solder pads. He touches a micro-soldering iron tip to the contact point, instantly liquefying the solder paste into a mirror-bright silver fillet. With the joint solidified, he retracts the iron and tweezers, leaving the complete power delivery stage fully installed. The camera glides horizontally in an extreme close-up tracking shot along the completed row of components.

shots.prompt: An overhead macro insert of the completed graphics card circuit board resting on a jade-green mat in soft daylight. The fully populated graphics card circuit board rests motionless on the jade-green cutting mat. At its center, the mirror-silver GPU die gleams on its dark carrier substrate, flanked symmetrically by black memory modules bearing laser-etched serial codes. Natural daylight glints across the copper traces and polished silicon. The camera drifts smoothly in a slow, continuous gliding pan looking straight down along the length of the board.

On the curved ultrawide screen, his race car crosses the finish line, triggering a bright first-place banner across the track. Alex thrusts the black wireless controller high above his head with both hands in victory, leaning back slightly in celebration as the water-cooled PC hums with bright green light beside the display. The camera holds a wide shot from directly behind the chair, framing Alex in silhouette against the brilliant screen and glowing PC tower.

shots.prompt: An expansive wide shot of the dark gaming room at late night, with Alex at his desk. Alex, a man with sandy-blond hair wearing a black T-shirt, black cargo trousers, and a black gaming headset, sits relaxed in his chair with the controller resting in his lap. He gazes peacefully toward the curved ultrawide monitor and the glowing neon-green cooling lines of the running PC tower. In the corner by the doorway, neatly flattened component boxes stand stacked, while the rolled-up green anti-static mat rests on a utility shelf above. The camera pulls back slowly from the desk setup into an expansive wide view of the nocturnal room.
